lines.beaver: 어서 와요, 민수 씨. 무슨 일 있어요?
lines.beaver_en: Come in, Minsu. Is something wrong?
lines.beaver_roman: eoseo wayo, minsu ssi. museun il isseoyo?
lines.en: Sir, I've come nervously to ask a favor.

lines.beaver_en: Don't be so nervous. What's the favor?
lines.learner: 다음 주 제 결혼식에서 축사를 해 주십사 하고요.
lines.en: I humbly ask you to give a speech at my wedding next week.
lines.roman: daeum ju je gyeolhonsigeseo chuksareul hae jusipsa hagoyo.

lines.beaver: 축사요? 갑자기 왜요? 원래 하실 분이 있었잖아요.
lines.beaver_en: A speech? Why so suddenly? Someone else was going to do it.
lines.beaver_roman: chuksayo? gapjagi waeyo? wollae hasil buni isseotjanayo.
lines.learner: 그분이 사정이 생겨서 못 오셔서 정말 당혹스러워요.
lines.en: Something came up and he can't come, so I'm really at a loss.
lines.roman: geubuni sajeongi saenggyeoseo mot osyeoseo jeongmal danghokseureowoyo.

lines.beaver: 그랬군요. 그런데 시간이 너무 빡빡하지 않아요?
lines.beaver_en: I see. But isn't the time very tight?
lines.beaver_roman: geuraetgunyo. geureonde sigani neomu ppakppakaji anayo?
lines.en: Urgent as it is, this is still a shameless request.

lines.beaver_en: Not at all. Busy as I am, how could I not help?
lines.en: Really? I was so restless, afraid you'd refuse.

lines.beaver: 그런데 왜 하필 저한테 부탁하는 거예요?
lines.beaver_en: But why ask me, of all people?
lines.beaver_roman: geureonde wae hapil jeohante butakaneun geoyeyo?
lines.learner: 고등학교 때 선생님 말씀에 큰 감명을 받았거든요.
lines.en: Your words deeply moved me in high school.
lines.roman: godeunghakgyo ttae seonsaengnim malsseume keun gammyeongeul badatgeodeunyo.

lines.beaver: 그렇게 말해 주니 고마워요. 그때가 생각나네요.
lines.beaver_en: Thank you for saying so. It brings back memories.
lines.beaver_roman: geureoke malhae juni gomawoyo. geuttaega saenggangnaneyo.
lines.learner: 선생님은 제게 은사인지라 꼭 모시고 싶었어요.
lines.en: Since you're my mentor, I really wanted you there.
lines.roman: seonsaengnimeun jege eunsainjira kkok mosigo sipeosseoyo.

lines.beaver: 좋아요. 그런데 저는 말주변이 없어서 걱정이에요.
lines.beaver_en: All right. But I'm worried, I'm not a good speaker.
lines.beaver_roman: joayo. geureonde jeoneun maljubyeoni eopseoseo geokjeongieyo.
lines.learner: 부담 갖지 마시고 편하게만 해 주세요.
lines.en: Don't feel pressured. Just speak comfortably.
lines.roman: budam gatji masigo pyeonhageman hae juseyo.

lines.beaver_en: Okay. I'll prepare something short and clear.
lines.en: Thank you! I was at a loss, but now I feel relieved.

lines.beaver: 결혼식 날 봐요. 행복한 날이 될 거예요.
lines.beaver_en: See you at the wedding. It'll be a happy day.
lines.beaver_roman: gyeolhonsik nal bwayo. haengbokan nari doel geoyeyo.
lines.en: Thank you. I'll be sure to see you that day!
